name: Occultus: The Craving
source:
Private detective Jane Malady is back for another adventure in the sequel to Occultus: Daughter of Darkness, this time she finds herself in the middle of a burgeoning conflict between two powerful factions of vampires.

Estranged from her old friends Malady is forced to make new alliances, the question is will they lead her astray? Will she betray them for a taste of power?

Will Malady give in to The Craving?

[From [url=https://bcg.itch.io/occultus-the-craving]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
私家侦探简·马拉迪在《神秘学：黑暗之女》续集中回归，展开另一场冒险，这一次她发现自己陷入了两个强大的吸血鬼派别之间日益激烈的冲突之中。

与老朋友疏远的马拉迪被迫结成新的联盟，问题是他们会把她引入歧途吗？她会为了尝到权力的滋味而背叛他们吗？

Malady会屈服于渴望吗？

[来自[url=https://bcg.itch.io/occultus-the-craving]Itch.io[/url]]
